name: Lotline
summary: A stock and supply app for a brand that makes its own products, with lots, POs and a forecast
about: An eight-page supply chain app for a small cosmetics maker in Islamabad. It tracks finished goods and raw materials by lot and expiry, runs purchase orders from draft to receiving, turns work orders into traceable lots and forecasts demand. A stock runway with a what-if demand slider and an animated supply flow show where the next shortage will come from.
how: Open a page from the icon rail; on a phone the menu button slides it in.
On Overview, drag the what-if demand slider: every product's days of cover moves live against its lead-time tick.
Click a supplier, material or product in the supply flow to trace its links; hover a link for the monthly spend.
In Inventory, lots sort first-expiry-first-out; quarantine or release a lot, and Dispatch picks the earliest good lots for you.
Create a purchase order, then Send, mark it in transit and Receive it: each line is booked in as a new lot with its expiry date.
Plan a work order, start it to issue materials and complete it to create a new traceable lot.
On Forecast, pick a product and horizon, then turn reorder suggestions into draft purchase orders with one click.
